items.title: PennEastern Architects LCC By dark project

items.title: Rechtsanwaltskanzlei Dr. Bien By aurora
items.detail: Rechtsanwaltskanzlei Dr. Bien — a specialist insolvency law firm in Hamm, NRW, appointed as insolvency administrator by 12 Amtsgerichte across Westfalen. The exposed material includes: 2,387 WinSolvenz case databases — each a Microsoft Access MDB containing the complete financial dossier of an insolvency debtor: creditor lists, claim amounts, distribution plans, asset inventories, court appointments, and bank account details. 492+ forced administration (Zwangsverwaltung) case files — property addresses, tenant data, rent records, utility accounts, insurance details, court-directed property management reports. 80 GB MailStore email archive — the firm's complete email history in MailStoreContainer-v1 format: attorney-client communications, court correspondence, creditor negotiations, debtor disclosures. 1.7 GB beA backup (besonderes elektronisches Anwaltspostfach) — three MSSQL database backups containing every electronic communication between the firm and every German court. 35 employee records — 25 former + ~10 current staff: contracts, salary, overtime, vacation, pension, disability status, termination agreements. DATEV tax/accounting archives — 33 directories of income tax backups, insolvency accounting, third-party mandates. Ransomware group claim; not independently verified. The observation/publication date is not the attack date.
